paragraphs: Manufacturing conglomerates, automotive suppliers, and consumer brands in Chennai face intense compliance stress when compiling monthly GSTR-1 return statements from thousands of sales invoices in Tally Prime. Inconsistent HSN summarization, mismatched customer GSTINs, and manual table segregation across B2B (Table 4A), large B2C (Table 5A), small B2C (Table 7), and exports (Table 6A) frequently trigger portal upload rejections and severe tax audit notices.

Our sovereign GST compilation engine interfaces directly with Tally Prime sales ledgers over local port 9000 XML sockets in Chennai. The agent extracts all outward supply vouchers, performs automated tax rate validation, and classifies transactions into statutory GSTR-1 tables. Discrepancies such as missing place of supply (POS) tags or invalid GSTIN checksums are flagged and corrected prior to payload generation.

The compilation state machine aggregates invoice data into the official GSTN JSON schema format in under 12 seconds. It cross-checks line-item HSN summaries against registered turnover thresholds to ensure compliance with mandatory 6-digit or 8-digit HSN reporting rules. When verified, the agent securely uploads the return payload to the GSTN portal via authorized GSP APIs with cryptographic digital signatures.

Statutory compliance satisfies Section 37 of the CGST Act 2017 and Rule 59 of the CGST Rules. The solution eliminates 90% of manual tax return preparation time, guarantees zero schema validation rejections on the GSTN portal, and ensures full input tax credit flow for enterprise customers.

faqs.question: How does the agent handle credit notes and debit notes issued against past period invoices?
faqs.answer: The state machine links credit and debit notes to original invoice numbers and dates, automatically populating Table 9B with statutory adjustment disclosures.

faqs.question: Can the system identify customer GSTIN status changes (such as cancellation or suspension)?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent validates all customer GSTINs against the government portal in real time, alerting sales teams if an invoice was issued to an inactive tax entity.

faqs.question: Does the agent support multi-GSTIN companies with branches in different Indian states?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform supports multi-state enterprise setups, consolidating or segregating sales returns per GSTIN branch automatically.
